fact_checks.quote: A firm, dry surface is best for harvest traffic and field-drying of hay. Also, because watering immediately after harvest stimulates the germination and growth of surface-germinated weeds it should be avoided when possible unless subsurface drip ir- rigation (SDI) systems are in use, which do not wet the soil surface during irrigation.
fact_checks.scope: Kansas State University irrigation guide for alfalfa; dry surface for harvest traffic and field drying; no fixed Iran rate prescribed

fact_checks.quote: Alfalfa is sensitive to water stress at the time of harvest, and rapid re-growth depends on ad- equate soil water. Watering prior to harvest or immediately after is the best time to promote rapid growth.
fact_checks.scope: Kansas State University alfalfa irrigation timing guidance; emphasizes soil-water dependence for regrowth, not Iran calendar

fact_checks.quote: An initial estimate or measurement of root- zone soil water is needed, which usually requires the installation of soil-water measuring equipment or soil probing.
fact_checks.scope: K-State scheduling methodology; root-zone measurement methods described, not fixed Iranian root depth or irrigation threshold
